video_title: SGA: “I Think I'm the Best Player in the NBA"

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on his goal of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: Every year I go into the season with one goal in mind and that's to win an NBA championship.
quotes.quote: Every year I go into the season with one goal in mind and that's to win an NBA championship. If I don't achieve that goal, then I fail that season. It's that simple for me.

quotes.speaker: Sean Gregory
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on winning three consecutive MVP awards
quotes.excerpt: It'd be hard to describe. So many things in my life that I've accomplished I never thought I would.

text_blocks.speaker: Sean Gregory
text_blocks.text: The last person to win three times in a row I believe was Larry Bird. Jordan hasn't done it, Kobe hasn't done it. What would it mean to you to win three MVPs in a row?

text_blocks.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
text_blocks.text: It'd be hard to describe. So many things in my life that I've accomplished I never thought I would, and I've been wild by it. I think the process and the approach that I take with playing the game and approaching the game has done me well to this point. I don't harp or focus on my achievements and what I'm trying to achieve, I just approach it the same way every day and hopefully I get where I want to go and do.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on handling external expectations and pressure
quotes.excerpt: Every year I play basketball and I've worked my butt off all summer to become a better basketball player.
quotes.quote: Every year I play basketball and I've worked my butt off all summer to become a better basketball player. And every year I go into the season trying to play my best basketball that I can and be the best player that I can. That's all that I worry about. Nothing else I can control besides trying to be the best version of myself for my group and the organization I play for.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on his unique, non-athletic scoring style
quotes.excerpt: I was never the most athletic, I was never the tallest, I was never the fastest.
quotes.quote: I was never the most athletic, I was never the tallest, I was never the fastest. I was very skinny, very small, so to get around the basketball court, to play with older guys, to stay on the court, I had to find ways to be elusive and ways to be tricky and ways to just be productive out there. Whether it was with the ball or without the ball, those reps and that just natural way of playing basketball for me became a weapon once I grew into my body and grew into my athleticism.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander claims to be the best player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think I'm the best player in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I think I'm the best player in the NBA. The production that I have night in and night out is best for an NBA production. The efficiency that I do it at is best for an NBA efficiency. And I think everybody picks up a basketball or a soccer ball or a football or a tennis ball to win the game, the match, whatever it is, and I've done my fair share of winning in these past couple years.
